text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tonight, a rare night race
will be held at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Last year, Mejiro Ramonu was scheduled to run,
but lighting issues forced a cancellation.
I'm just glad it's going ahead without a hitch this year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: It had better be.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It's a secret rendezvous I've waited a whole year for, after all.
...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu's maddening passion,
aged over a year specifically for this race.
Unleashing it should give momentum to future races as well.
choice_data_list: Enjoy yourself to the fullest tonight!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I am coming now.
To you, my beloved of the night.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Fufu...! Ahaha, hahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—There's no waaaay anyone could beat that!!
—She's on a completely different level...!?

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Turning into the straight, the leader is Mejiro Ramonu!
The lead widens to two, then three lengths!
And now—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"A moisture-laden breeze...
The cheers echo even louder than they did during the day..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Even on the same turf, you show a different face... Hehe.
So this is the side you show tonight..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having seized an overwhelming victory, Mejiro Ramonu returned.
Her expression was dignified, yet carried a dreamy air about it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The exchange event held on campus after this will be
attended by people closely tied to the Mejiro family.
She really ought to go make the rounds, but..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Oh?
Are you quite sure?
choice_data_list: Yeah. Once everything's taken care of, I'll come pick you up.
Yeah. Once everything is done, I'll come pick you up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Then... I shall leave it to you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing the rounds of greetings,
I came to pick up Mejiro Ramonu as promised.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The message that arrived after that contained only a single sentence:
"I'm at the sea."
choice_data_list: Sorry to keep you waiting, Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...It's lovely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Following Mejiro Ramonu's gaze, I saw a path of light shining brilliantly across the sea under the moonlight.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I overlapped my feelings with the roar of the sea.
My thoughts for that person, on this very night."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Still, a full moon in June...
If I make my vow... will it guide me once more, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Then... I'd like one.
A witness to verify the proof, that is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, would you take me there?
All the way to that moonlit path."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I want you to hear this.
My words of vow, dedicated to that person.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I take Ramonu by the hand and walk toward the water's edge,
as if escorting a bride.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Listening to the sound of the ocean waves like that,
a distant memory quietly resurfaces.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I remember how my heart wouldn't stop pounding
the first time I ever saw her run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I signed our trainer contract,
I resolved to support her dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Every time those thoughts cross my mind, it deeply hits me.
From the bottom of my heart, I—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"...I swear it.
My beloved."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
An expression different from the daytime, and this heat running through my body……
I won't ever forget it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Let us meet again.
Beneath the very same moon...
choice_data_list: I'll help out so you can have a happy race.
I'll help out so you can have a happy race.
I'd love to see you all dressed up again, too.
I want to see you in all your glory again, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Let us meet again.
Beneath the very same moon...
choice_data_list: I'll help out so you can have a happy race.
I'll help out so you can have a happy race.
I'd love to see you all dressed up again, too.
I want to see you in all your glory again, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I see.
...I'll leave it in your hands, then."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing those words in response,
I vowed in my heart to do my best once more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —I have high hopes for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"To your escort
from here on out."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh, really?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Then I must polish it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that laugh, Mejiro Ramonu kept her gaze
fixed upon the moon for some time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
By the way,
would you mind telling me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Tonight's race,
as seen from your perspective.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I had a lively discussion about
racing with Mejiro Ramonu.
